dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Toying with life and death is a futile endeavor!

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: If King Deshret could rise from the sands, so could Greater Lord Rukkhadevata sprout from the soil!

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: King Deshret is long gone. Those wannabes don't deserve the title of the Eremites if they can't even face it!

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Death is the fairest thing in the world. A god high above or a bug deep in dirt, it comes for everyone all the same.
